description:
Get daily Google Search Console metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) for one or more page URLs within a property. Pass a single page (url) or up to 50 at once (urls array — mutually exclusive with url); the bulk form returns a results array with one daily series per URL, keyed by the input. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or as absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d format). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Daily GSC metrics for a single page over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","url":"https://example.com/pricing","range":"last_28_days"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.

urls.description: Up to 50 page URLs to fetch at once. Mutually exclusive with url.
